adjudication.rationale: The diff shows duplicated logic for fetching a credential from DB and then mapping it into a `CredentialWithAppName`-like object. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` inside `createAllCalendarEvents`, when `credential` isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it calls `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true } } }, where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` and then maps fields into a new `credential` object. A very similar block appears later in the same file in the calendar-update path (looping `for (const reference of calendarReference)`), again fetching with `include.app.slug` and remapping into the same shape. Separately, `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` adds another fallback `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` without including `app.slug`, which is an inconsistent variant. This is a maintainability/architecture issue (DRY + consistency) grounded in the diff, not a directly verifiable functional defect on its own.
